name: A sample
description: one physical tube or well that exists: which construct it is, which clone, what host strain it is in, whether it is a glycerol stock, plasmid DNA, a fragment or a culture, its concentration as a state word, and where it is in which box
phrases: the shape of a sample record
where is the tube of this construct

construct.description: the design's name. One design, many samples

clone.description: which isolate, when there is more than one

host.description: the strain it is in, if it is cells

concentration.description: a state word, not a number (ONTOLOGY tier 2)

location.description: ONTOLOGY tier 2's Location, as src/inventory/io.js reads and writes it

untracked.description: set by the inventory reader for a row it could not place

source.description: where this record was read from: a pointer at a line in an inventory file, never a copy of it

path.description: repo-relative path to the inventory file

notes:
ONTOLOGY tier 2's Sample made checkable. NO `experiment` FIELD (JCA, 2026-10-22): the experiment lists its samples (experiment.schema). 'What is in the -80' is reached project -> experiments -> samples where form is glycerol.

LOCATION IS C6's OWN, {boxname, row, col, label, sidelabel}, as src/inventory/README.md types it. The draft proposed {box, well, ...} as the oligo schema has it; the inventory code is what already reads and writes samples, so its shape wins.

This schema has no conforming instances yet; the first inventory rows validated against it are its test.
